label: First load: show the spinner, drop an old error
code: is Action.Load -> state.copy(loading = true, error = null)

label: Pull to refresh: keep the list on screen
code: is Action.Refresh -> state.copy(refreshing = true, error = null)

label: Fresh orders arrived
code: is Action.Loaded -> state.copy(orders = action.orders, loading = false, refreshing = false, error = null)

label: The request failed
code: is Action.LoadFailed -> state.copy(loading = false, refreshing = false, error = action.message)
